timezone_resolution_context._note: Operator HQ is in Toronto (America/Toronto). This Simphony location is in Vancouver (America/Vancouver). The vendor emits UTC; the location's bound IANA zone in connector_connection.metadata is America/Vancouver, NOT the operator's HQ zone. Business date resolution uses the location's zone, not the operator's HQ. cmplOrClsdUTC = 2026-05-03T06:35:00Z = 2026-05-02T23:35:00 local Vancouver. With 04:00 local cutoff, business_date = 2026-05-02. If the framework wrongly used the operator's Toronto zone, business_date would resolve to 2026-05-03 (02:35 ET, post-cutoff = 2026-05-03 day in Toronto).
